user.title: Sveglie
user.description: Adds voice alarms. After setup just tell your assistant: "set an alarm for 7" (Italian phrases are tuned best).

data_description.dispositivo_predefinito: Where an alarm rings when it was set from somewhere that is not a satellite (e.g. the app chat).
data_description.minuti_posticipo: How far snooze moves the alarm. Alexa uses 9.
data_description.recupero_minuti: If Home Assistant was down at alarm time and comes back within these minutes, the alarm rings right away.
